//! `greeting list`'s workload.

pub(crate) fn workload() -> crate::measure::Measured {
    crate::measure::rounds(
        "greeting/list",
        || (),
        |()| {
            let line = <cli::resources::greeting::list::command::ListArguments as clap::Args>::augment_args(
                clap::Command::new("list"),
            );
            let arguments = <cli::resources::greeting::list::command::ListArguments as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches(
                &line.get_matches_from(["list"]),
            );
            assert!(arguments.is_ok(), "`greeting list` parses with no arguments");
            let Ok(arguments) = arguments else { return };
            let outcome = cli::resources::greeting::list::command::run(arguments);
            assert_eq!(
                outcome,
                cli::outcome::Outcome::Success,
                "`greeting list` did not succeed"
            );
        },
    )
}
